examples.output: We extend at the edge (packages, clerk) rather than change the core, unless the process has settled.

aiGuidance.extraction: Look for the moment agreement is reached — signalled by so we are agreed, let us go with, or a direct statement of resolution. Extract the commitment itself, not the discussion around it. One sentence.
aiGuidance.purpose: States one standing choice in one concise, active-voice sentence. It is the record of what was decided, not why. It must be one thing, timeless and testable: it reads true with every date, issue number and id removed, and someone can apply it to a new case and say whether the case conforms.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not include dates, issue numbers, record ids or "today" and "this session"; those are provenance and belong in relations and context. Do not join two choices with "and"; split them into two decisions. Do not record a task or the result of applying a rule (owner ruling D1).

description: The one standing, timeless, testable choice, in one active-voice sentence.
instructions: Write the settled commitment as one clear sentence in the active voice. State one standing choice that will still read true next month, and that a later case can be checked against. Leave out dates, issue numbers and ids. If it needs "and" to hold two choices, split it.
name: decision_statement
